name: What is the difference between quartz and granite countertops?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between quartz and granite countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice depends on maintenance preferences, daily use, and appearance. Quartz is engineered stone that is non-porous, highly stain-resistant, and never requires sealing, making it ideal for busy kitchens. Granite is natural stone that handles direct heat exceptionally well and features unique, one-of-a-kind veining, but it requires periodic sealing to resist liquid absorption and staining. In terms of durability, both resist scratches and chips well under normal kitchen conditions, though sudden heavy impacts on edges can chip either surface.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quartz is non-porous and never requires sealing, while natural granite offers higher heat resistance and unique natural patterns but needs routine sealing.
